verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official MCP Server that gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to its Admin/Management API. Agents can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options and release workflows, either in a human-in-the-loop IDE session or fully automated in CI/CD, and a probe confirms the official docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and documented connection, auth and setup details or a tool inventory.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol
Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf — in a human-in-the-loop IDE session, or fully automated in a CI/CD pipeline.
